notes.title: Mod creators need to update their mods using version 1.3 of the modding tool for them to work again with V0.8.5.

items.text: Updated the modding tool to version 1.3.
Added a shortcut for quick purchases in the Shop and Stock menus, available on both controller and keyboard and mouse.
Added an indicator that shows when an expansion is available to purchase.
Changed the unlock level for Carrot Cake from level 30 to level 36.
Changed the unlock level for the Cake Ingredients Shelf (Chocolate) from level 65 to level 36.
Removed the Halloween event.
Fixed an incorrect price displayed on the handheld scanner.
Fixed an issue that prevented the Halloween event board from working.
Fixed a bug that caused the music to play twice for the host in multiplayer.
Fixed an issue that prevented the jewelry display’s area from being shown.
Fixed an expansion description that omitted the additional checkout spots it unlocks.

Fixed an issue that prevented modded shelves from being saved across game updates. Due to the change to the save system, existing modded shelves will disappear one last time when you update to V0.8.5.
Fixed several translations.
🎄 Get your shelves ready for the holidays! Christmas is coming to your supermarket on December 4, 2026, with our next content update.
Fixed a shelf replication issue in multiplayer.
Fixed achievement progression on Steam. (A fix for achievements on Epic Games and PlayStation will be available soon.)
Fixed a performance issue when holding the handheld scanner.
Fixed an issue causing products on pallets stored in the cold room to expire.
Fixed an issue preventing some pallets from being picked up.
Cross-play between the PC versions is working again! 🎉 Halloween items are also now available on PS5! 🎃
TSR / TAA Resolution: Added a setting to adjust the resolution percentage. The default value is set to 100% to prevent decorations from flickering.
Carrots: The unlock level has been changed from level 65 to level 29.
Performance: Improved overall performance and reduced loading times.
Pallets: Fixed visual issues with employees moving pallets.
Halloween Items: Fixed an issue that prevented customers from complaining about missing Halloween items.
Restocking: Fixed an issue that allowed restockers to restock any shelf.
Twitch Integration: Fixed an issue that prevented settings from being saved after closing the settings menu.
Halloween Item Prices: Fixed an issue that prevented Halloween item prices from being changed.
Multiplayer: Fixed a major performance drop in multiplayer sessions.
Skins: Fixed skin display issues, including clothing and visible meshes.
PlayStation: Fixed an issue that prevented the "Continue" button from working.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494584/337dc975928d033a837e1852d8ff95f612d411ff.png"]
Halloween has arrived in Better Mart Simulator! Discover a special event, 25 limited-time items, and a new permanent cake to fill your display cases.

This update also introduces community events and Twitch integration, allowing viewers to interact with streamers during their games! You'll also find quality-of-life improvements, optimizations, and numerous fixes for both single-player and multiplayer.
Added community events, available for a limited time. If the community reaches the goal, the reward will be available to all players, including those who did not participate and future players!
Added Twitch integration, allowing viewers to interact with streamers while they play.
Added the Halloween event.
Added 25 limited-time Halloween-themed items.
Added a permanent Halloween cake, unlocked at level 30.
Restored the missing “Jewelry” decorative furniture item. (Its name will be corrected in the coming days.)
Added credits for the artists who created some of the game's icons.
Improved controller navigation in the employee menu.
Adjusted the scrolling speed when holding certain buttons: slower at first, then faster.
The “Pallet” furniture item now unlocks at level 7.
The “Fruit and Vegetables” scale now unlocks at level 25.
Reorganized the apps on the computer and removed the app announcing the release of Better Chaos.
The main menu now displays the latest game news instead of the image of the month.
The pallet stacker can no longer switch between modes (“Stack,” “Unstack,” or “Sell”) while being repaired.
Restocking employees now prioritize items that their coworkers are not already restocking.
Optimized performance when employees stock shelves.
Removed the continuous shopping cart sound in the menu.
Fixed an issue causing the game to launch without a menu when the settings file was corrupted.
Fixed several translation errors across various languages.
Fixed shelf saving, which did not correctly preserve shelf layouts.
Fixed controller access to the different bank loans.
Fixed the gem count display at the start of a game.
Fixed controller scrolling in the level rewards menu used to unlock items with gems.
Fixed an issue preventing cake employees from restocking ingredients.
Fixed an issue causing employees to restock ingredient shelves from the wrong side.
Fixed the loss of controller focus when attempting to join a session.
Fixed rack labels not updating correctly.
Fixed invisible objects on pallets.
Fixed saving the language selected in the settings on PS5.
Fixed an issue showing that some pallets still contained boxes when they were empty.
Fixed the “Fresh Products” indicator appearing on some pallets for no reason.
Fixed the placement of certain furniture items.
Fixed the “cake-everywhere” bug and floating cakes that remained after the end of a day.
Fixed the rotation of modded items on checkout conveyor belts.
Fixed the expansion door on the left side of the store unlocking when purchasing the cold room.
Fixed labels not appearing when using the pallet stacker truck.
Fixed text not moving with racks and the pallet stacker.
Fixed an issue allowing achievements to be unlocked in modded games.
Fixed issues causing customers and employees to become invisible.
Fixed boxes remaining in players' hands.
Fixed collision issues with certain boxes.
Fixed an issue causing the host to become invisible in some games.
Fixed an issue preventing employees from pausing their work.
Fixed the synchronization of the spoiled state of pallets containing rotten products for client players.
Fixed pallet visibility issues between the host and client players.

Enjoying Better Mart Simulator and this new update? Please consider leaving a positive review on the game's Steam page! Your reviews help more players discover the game and support its continued development.

topNew: Added Twitch integration, allowing viewers to interact with streamers while they play.

items.text: Before we get into the changes: Better Chaos launches on October 1! Our new game invites you to restore order to a huge supermarket where 32,141 items have been scattered across the store. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, add it to your Steam wishlist:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5138000/Better_Chaos/"]
And if you want to play with friends, Better Mart Simulator supports PC–PS5 crossplay! Steam and PlayStation 5 players can play together in the same session.
Updated the modding tool to version 1.2.
Added a setting to adjust controller sensitivity when aiming at an interactable object.
Added descriptions to ingredient shelves and several machines.
Added an option to easily reset controller or keyboard bindings in the settings.
Reduced camera sensitivity when aiming at an interactable object with a controller, making it easier to select.
Improved the readability of category text.
Improved controller navigation in the settings menu.
Improved the pallet teleport button so it now teleports only pallets on the floor, as intended.
Fixed an issue that prevented controller players from loading an older save using the clock icon.
Fixed several translation errors.
Fixed the clothing table refusing to accept certain items.
Fixed modded sessions being treated as unmodded after every restart, which caused a new save to be created each time.
Fixed the oven tutorial not displaying correctly.
Fixed controller navigation resetting after hiring or firing an employee.
Fixed a memory leak affecting non-host players in multiplayer.
Fixed controller button rebinding: the default button remained active alongside the newly assigned button.
Added support for several more languages.
Fixed audio issues.
Fixed missing textures on some items.
Fixed a crash when saving the game.
Fixed issues that could corrupt save files.
Removed the saving of recaps, which took up too much storage space.
Thank you all for playing Better Mart Simulator and supporting us through each update! Your feedback helps us keep improving the game. 💙
If you’re enjoying your time in the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam or PlayStation. Every review means a lot to our small team of three.
The Exanticx Studio team
Updated mods for version V1.1 of the mod project. (We are in no way responsible for mods, as they are not part of the base game.)
Added a new sound for the truck horn (1% chance of getting it).
Added a new cake at level 252.
Added 7 new items at levels 253, 254, 255, 257, 258, 259, and 260.
Updated the description of the fish scale.
The two decorative plants that were in the "jewelry" category are now in the "plants" category.
Reduced hiring costs to match the price of a daily wage.
Reset "modded" saves.
Fixed saves opened without mods that were becoming "modded" without having installed any mods.
Fixed certain words that had incorrect translations in several languages.
Fixed vehicle reset that was teleporting the cart outside.
Fixed the fish scale not being repaired by employees.
Fixed new saves being unfairly counted as modded.
Fixed empty signs that would automatically write the player's username when the save was reloaded.
Fixed the tutorial to get rid of a pallet that was displaying incorrectly after checking out.
Fixed several achievements that weren't working.
Fixed the day counter displayed at the start of the day, which showed placeholder text for a few seconds.
Fixed an error message that no longer appeared when hovering over a shelf with an item in hand that doesn't have the correct support.

On the agenda: Discover the fish counter, 44 new items, 9 new pieces of furniture, 10 additional levels, a cart that can carry up to 12 boxes, 19 new Steam achievements, and numerous multiplayer improvements. This update also marks the official release of the modding tool as version 1.0, along with many new features, optimizations, and fixes.
We've worked hard on the modding tool to add many additional features for modders. The tool is now officially at version 1.0 and will continue to evolve based on community feedback.
Mods upgraded to "v1". WARNING: mods that have not been updated to version 1 will show the message "Mod loading error."
Added 44 new items: fish, packaged fish, sushi, and makis.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494584/cf88c494940b06d5da86b385d6d14a316d504c64.gif"]
Added 9 pieces of furniture.
Added 10 additional levels.
Added 2 extensions for the cold room.
Added 3 shelves for storing the ingredients needed to make cakes.
Added a "Bakery" category in the "Furniture" tab to group all furniture related to cake making.
Added a cart that can carry up to 12 different boxes at once.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494584/c82e65f38901cce247b9269ddab6a8ef0b358665.gif"]

Added a label and warning message for saves that have never been launched with mods, shown when mods are installed. Note: once a save has been launched with a mod even once, achievements are permanently disabled for it, even if the mod is later removed.
Added automatic duplication of an unmodified save when it's launched with mods.
Added the ability to choose the name of the copy when manually duplicating a save.
Added the ability to enable or disable mods directly in-game. Their state is now preserved after restarting the game.
Added several improvements to the "Store Upgrades" menu on the computer.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494584/68f8e95640c5302bd32a0099fb49baf0d8d9ec35.png"]
Employees assigned to cakes can now refill ingredient containers.
Added a tutorial dedicated to the cake furniture.
Added a notification on the computer's "Store Upgrades" icon when an unlocked extension hasn't been purchased yet.
Added a computer feature to teleport boxes, pallets, and vehicles.
Added a "Texture" button letting new players more easily change wall and floor textures.
Added 2 new appearances for butcher and fishmonger employees.
Added an animation for when cake ingredient containers are filled.
Added 19 Steam achievements.
Added new decorations.
Added an end-of-day bonus.
Added a graphics option to choose the anti-aliasing method. TAA is now supported and uses far fewer graphics resources while offering visual quality very close to the TSR already present in the game.
Added real-time performance display in the game settings menu.
Added a new tutorial explaining how to store pallets.
Added a cost for hiring employees.
Added an option to place the third-person camera to the left of the character.
Employees' "Paused" state is now saved and preserved when moving to the next day, as well as after restarting the game.
Air conditioning now unlocks at level 3.
The mods button is now shown even when no mods are installed.
The frame rate limit is now set to 60 by default for new players.
Modified several decorations.
The 8 items given for free at the start of a game are now optional if the tutorial is disabled when creating the game.
Changed the appearance of the button used to open or close the store for the day.
Reduced the amount of XP required to reach each level.
Improved loading times for modded games.
Improved the animation of shelf labels when they are far from the player.
Improved the XP gain animation when the reward is received in a menu. The animation no longer follows the cursor and works better with a controller.
Improved reflections on the game's windows.
Improved the third-person camera.
Improved several decorations and added various particle effects to some of them.
Improved the resolution of certain textures.
Improved variety of employee resumes: the same character can no longer appear on two resumes on the same day.
Reduced the display duration of the Photo mode notification.
Reduced CPU and GPU load to improve game performance.
Reduced the frequency of customer help requests.
Removed the setting to change the draw distance. It is now set to "High Quality" for all players.
Removed the XP gained from purchasing an item license.
Fixed save data that wasn't correctly duplicated until the copied game had been saved at least once.
Fixed an issue preventing re-duplicating a save under the same name after deleting its first copy.
Fixed certain data that wasn't deleted when deleting a game.
Fixed item supports on pallets, which no longer displayed when hovering over a pallet.
Fixed Photo mode, which didn't always activate correctly.
Fixed player orientation, which could end up facing away from the store after a day.
Fixed preview images for certain items that were misaligned on several boxes.
Fixed spelling of several item names.
Fixed the preview of the future security employee, which was no longer displaying.
Fixed keyboard and mouse support in Big Picture mode and on Steam Deck.
Fixed several 3D text display issues.
Fixed white lines that could appear above the incinerator.
Fixed the positioning of ceiling lights.
Fixed the default game configuration, which wasn't always applied on first launch.
Fixed categories and items that sometimes appeared outside their zone in the "Market," "Collection," and "Summary" menus.
Fixed the BetterCoins logo, which showed a dollar symbol for French players.
Fixed the end-of-day notification, which showed the following day instead of the day that had just ended.
Fixed the outline color of items when hovering over a shelf.
Fixed the color of racks and decorations, which didn't update after placing a new item.
Fixed loss of controller focus in the end-of-day summary.
Fixed the clothing rack, which still showed clothes after customers had taken them.
Fixed several items sticking out of their boxes in registers and carts.
Fixed an issue that could corrupt a new game if the player quit before the first autosave or before making a manual save.
Fixed cleaning employees, who could stop working if the player cleaned a stain in their place.
Fixed labels that showed no price for jewelry and clothing.
Fixed the pallet jack and stacker, which lost their pallet when picked up by the player.
Fixed cake boxes that remained floating in the air after firing an employee assigned to cakes.
Added an error message for unexpected disconnection from a multiplayer game.
Added the ability to kick a player from the game.
Temporarily removed the display of the number of items sold for non-host players (as it was causing other issues).
Fixed significant slowdowns for non-host players.
Fixed synchronization of unlocked items in the gems menu for games with a high number of daily sales.
Fixed the end-of-day summary, which no longer displayed for non-host players in games with a high number of daily sales.
Fixed menus that didn't close when the end of day was triggered by another player.
Fixed the display of XP at the register for non-host players.
Fixed the texture of expired boxes, which didn't display for non-host players.
Fixed synchronization of pipe display in the store between the host and other players.
Fixed the Pause menu, which could pause the game in multiplayer when opened by a non-host player.
Fixed the multiplayer game creation menu, which didn't work correctly with a controller.
Fixed synchronization of prices displayed on shelf labels.
Fixed the pallet jack and stacker in multiplayer, which could keep a pallet after a non-host player placed it there.
Added a progress bar for each item subcategory.
Added 23 game-related statistics to the Collection menu.
Added the "Modded items only" filter.
Items are now sorted in ascending order by unlock level.
Changed the "Don't show categories" mode: items are no longer grouped by category, so as to respect their ascending order by level.
Added a "NEW" label on items unlocked at the previous level.
Added the "Modded items only" and "New items only" filters.
Changed the animation shown after unlocking an item.
Fixed the "Mod" label, which didn't display on modded items.
Fixed the item unlock animation, which didn't display correctly with a controller.
A huge thank you to everyone supporting Better Mart Simulator, whether you've been here since the very beginning or joined us along the way.
Every day, we work with passion to improve the game and give you the most complete and immersive supermarket management experience possible.

If you're enjoying the game and this new update, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam. For a small indie studio like ours, every review counts enormously: it helps the game gain visibility, reach new players, and allows us to keep developing even more content.
It will only take you a few moments, but for us, it can truly make all the difference.
And above all, stay tuned… A great surprise is coming very soon, and something tells us the chaos is only just beginning. 👀
Added multiplayer achievement support.
Added the ability to pause all employees at the same time.
Changed the gem menu, which now saves the "Show categories" state after closing the menu.
Changed the game loading interface to indicate mod loading. (mod loading was previously included under the "Shelf loading" label)
Changed the end-of-day recap animation.
Changed the shopping cart, which now displays a maximum order of 60 pallets until the 3rd extension is purchased.
Increased the XP required for the first levels.
Decreased the loading time for modded games.
Decreased the height of the number of items placed on the "Appliance Pallet Shelf."
Optimized in-game textures, which are now lighter.
Fixed in-game brightness that was no longer correct.
Fixed incorrect XP earned details.
Fixed employee names and photos that didn't match the skin's gender.
Fixed the computer that had disappeared from the "Machines" tab.
Fixed 6 animal items that were in the "Dog" category and are now back in the "Cat" category.
Fixed the appliance shelf that was not at the correct level; it goes from level 38 to 31.
Fixed the number of items sold that was not displaying the correct number in the end-of-day recap.
Fixed a display bug on certain dirt/grime in-game.
Fixed the 3 chicken trays that were moved to the "Chicken" category (was in "Deli").
Fixed some supports/stands that were no longer displaying.
Fixed customers displaying thank-you messages after not having been helped.
Fixed the replication of box positions in multiplayer.
Fixed the display of achievement progress on Steam and Epic Games.

Don't forget to leave a positive review on the game's Steam page. It's the greatest reward we could receive after all the work invested, and we always take immense pleasure in reading each of your reviews carefully.

notes.title: Following feedback from many players, we have increased the amount of experience gained to make progression smoother and more rewarding.

items.text: Added a detailed display of XP earned.
Increased the XP received from satisfied customers.
Improved the appearance of dirt stains.
Optimized VRAM usage: less powerful computers will display fewer blurry textures.
Fixed and updated the modding tool to version 0.13.
Fixed customers getting stuck outside the store, throwing trash outside, and asking for help outside.
Fixed the nickname selection interface not working for keyboard and mouse players.

Don't forget to leave a positive review on the game's Steam page. It is the greatest reward we could receive after all the work invested, and we always take great pleasure in reading each of your comments carefully.
Optimized particle performance,

Don't forget to leave a positive review on the game's Steam page. It's the best reward we could receive after all the work we've put in, and we always take great pleasure in reading each of your comments carefully.

Fixed the belt-shelf unit.

Fixed the pallet jack that disappeared when the player was between the truck and the dock.

Fixed the item count in the summary that was out of sync and no longer worked in multiplayer.
Fixed the Anniversary and Easter 2026 trophies, now available again in the shop.
Fixed non-host players being able to get infinite XP by removing an item and then placing it back on the same shelf.
Fixed the displayed amount of XP earned in the summary.
Fixed the item purchase animation for controller players.
Fixed the preview menu when hovering with a controller over items in the shop or collection menu, which displayed off-screen for items on the right.
Fixed a visual issue with items sticking out of boxes.
Fixed the displayed item quantity and sold item details in the summary that weren't showing in multiplayer.
Fixed several shelves displaying the wrong shelf type in the store menu.

Don't forget to leave a positive review on the game's Steam page. It's the best reward we could receive after all the work we've put in, and we always take great pleasure in reading each of your comments carefully.

Happy 1st Anniversary to Better Mart Simulator! 🎈

items.text: 1️⃣ Fruit and Vegetable Shelf Redesign
We have completely reworked the shelf with the blue crates due to several bugs.
👉 All fruits and vegetables still placed on this shelf will be removed during the update.
We strongly recommend emptying the crates before the update to avoid any loss.
Note: The crates will no longer be used in the new version.
2️⃣ Removal of Crate #1
Crate #1 will be removed from your save files, as it is now a freely placeable object. (As a reminder, this crate was free 😉)
3️⃣ Locker Removal
Lockers will no longer be usable and will be removed from your save files.
They are replaced by a brand new staff management system, now accessible directly from the in-game computer.
Lockers will return as decorative items in a future update.

Added an animation for the cashiers when customers check out at the register.

Added an animation for the customers when they're taking an item.

Addition of a desk with a functional computer that can be bought and placed down in the warehouse.
The meat products now have a red colored box to better spot them in the warehouse.
The hygiene products now have a green colored box to better spot them in the warehouse.

The customers' shopping carts now are visually smaller by 10%.

Fixed bugs of synchronization for the sound effects/sfx.

notes.title: Thank you for playing and being part of the adventure!

items.text: Your support means a lot and helps shape the future updates of the game.
If you have a few minutes, leaving a short review on Steam would really help improve the game's visibility and guide us on what to focus on next.
Even just a few honest lines about what you enjoyed, what you didn’t, or what you'd like to see more of can make a big difference.
Thanks again! 😊
The price of tomatoes has changed.
Fixed a bug causing items to be offset to the side.
Fixed a bug causing items to remain tiny.
Fixed a bug where checkouts would disappear (they disappear once, but after reconnecting they stay visible).
Adjusted the quantity of some items on specific shelves.
Added a new restocker: "Distributor".
Added the ability to delete labels.
Fixed a bug causing restockers to freeze and not find tasks to do.
Added a sound when selling a pallet using the pallet stacker.
Fixed a bug where customers would freeze when trying to go to checkout or other locations.
Customers now leave without paying if the queue exceeds 7 people.
Fixed a bug where the "New Game" button wouldn't work.

Fixed a bug that caused the "Continue" button to crash the game (warning, loading a corrupted save will still crash the game, but you’ll be able to choose an older save of your game) (play time, save colors, and number of days on a save will update after saving your games again).
Added a loading bar when loading a game.
Added multiple background images for the loading screen.
Fixed a bug causing the background image to change during loading.
Added a button to delete all your saves.
Fixed a bug where play time displayed on a save was shorter than actual time played.
Added a sound effect when adding items to cart.
Lowered the ambient noise from shopping carts.
Changed the notification sound when an action is impossible (red or yellow pop-ups).
Reduced video memory usage.
Improved performance with a large number of customers in the store.
Overall performance improvements.
Reduced loading times for single-player and multiplayer.
Reduced item loading times in the store menu, collection menu, and stock menu.
Fixed a bug where non-host players couldn't reset labels properly.
Fixed a bug where non-host players couldn't see restocker's color, name, or status.
Fixed a bug where the player got soft-locked at the computer with no visible mouse after opening the PC during the tutorial close animation.
Enlarged the player detection area that updates the dock timer before the truck arrives.
Visual and audio overhaul of in-game notifications.
Fixed a bug where pinging (middle mouse click) stopped working in the English version.
Your support means a lot and helps shape the future updates of the game.
If you have a few minutes, leaving a short review on Steam would really help improve the game's visibility and guide us on what to focus on next.
Even just a few honest lines about what you enjoyed, what you didn’t, or what you'd like to see more of can make a big difference.
Thanks again! 😊

Fixed a bug where the pallet stacker wouldn’t work with the forklift.

Fixed a bug where pallets were not detected by the pallet stacker.
Rack labels are now mandatory.
Restockers will now place pallets on unassigned spots if no assigned spots are available.
Added the ability to change sign colors. (Solo only for the moment)
Added a description for the "Dispenser" item.
Performance optimizations.
Fixed a bug that caused scales to be deleted from save files.
Fixed incorrect display of the control instruction menu (bottom right).
Fixed a bug preventing the purchase of store extensions.
Fixed a translation error on the cashier screen.
Fixed a bug that prevented the white locker bubble from appearing.
Fixed a bug that displayed incorrect customer numbers in the recap statistics.
Fixed visual bugs on items from the "Hygiene" pack.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494584/ee5e42aa2981f204fc3689a723f03b9a354cdca2.png"]
The restocker now correctly fills the new bread shelf.
Restockers no longer collide with storage racks; their pathfinding has been adjusted.
Fixed placement zones for decorative elements.
Trays no longer disappear from bakery furniture.
NPCs no longer get stuck under the parking lot, resolving the end-of-day summary freeze.
Cars remain disabled for now. They will return in a future content update.
Fixed the issue causing the stacker to disappear.

Dear players,
Today we are releasing a new patch that fixes the many bugs you reported to us in Steam discussions and on the official Discord.
Some bugs are still being investigated, tested, and fixed for a future patch.
We thank you very much for all your feedback and reports, both positive and negative.
This allows us to improve our game and do everything possible to satisfy you.

Removed the wall that flies above the store.
Fixed the store name synchronization in multiplayer!

💠Fixed a bug that prevented bakery counters from being saved.

🔶SIGN🔶
💠Added 21 flags as sign images.
💠Fixed a game crash when editing sign text.
🔶STOCK🔶

🔶CUSTOMER🔶
💠Customers now look at the cashier when paying at the register.

💠Fixed a bug that caused items to teleport when picking up an item from the shelf.

💠Improved the two camera modes when using the forklift.
🔶PALETE STAKER🔶
💠The pallet stacker now automatically stacks pallets.

The Exanticx Studio team
